summary: Backlog epic and root, Solution Design, Design System and Operation contract reviews can run as review panels: parallel read-only lens readers declared as validated data in `challenge-review/data/review-panels.json`, merged by root cause, approved only without an open critical or major finding and re-reviewed by lens. A panel replaces the step's single reviewer, including the Solution primary reviewer. The process switch `review_panels` in a project's Process Policy selects the panel at `lens_panel` and ships at `single_reader`, so every review runs as before, with its released instructions, until a project sets the switch or a later release promotes it. At `lens_panel` the backlog review manifest names that value and carries a `check` block of compiler facts that the panel's lens readers take as given; at `single_reader` a reader's manifest carries no compiler facts, as before.
